title: Lemon herb roast chicken
summary: A simple roast with lemon, garlic and thyme. Rub the bird with salt, tuck the herbs under the skin, and roast until the skin is deep gold. Let it rest before carving so the juices stay put.

title: One-pot mushroom pasta
summary: Creamy, cozy, and ready in about thirty minutes. Mushrooms, a splash of cream, and one pot to wash. A green salad is plenty on the side.

title: Blueberry oat muffins
summary: Hearty muffins that keep well and freeze even better. Oats in the batter, berries folded in at the end. Bake a dozen and tuck half in the freezer for later.

title: Houseplants that thrive in winter
summary: A gentle guide to keeping greenery happy when the days get short. Less water, a brighter windowsill, and no fussing. Most of them just want to be left alone until spring.

title: A walking tour of Kingston’s old town
summary: Five easy stops, good coffee, and a view of the water. A made-up wander from a harbour wall to a bakery and a little bookshop. Wear shoes you can walk in.

title: The science of a good night’s sleep
summary: What actually helps, without the usual fluff. A dark room, a regular hour, and the phone left in the kitchen. The rest is mostly habit, not a gadget.

title: When the group chat goes quiet
summary: The silence after you share a very enthusiastic recipe. Three bubbles, a photo of the bowl, and then nothing. The pasta is still excellent.

title: The “I just sat down” cat
summary: That look when someone asks for a favour the second you sit down. The cat has just arranged itself on the chair and would like this moment to last. It is not getting up.

title: Library holds to pick up
summary: The Thursday Murder Club, a knitting book, and that baking memoir. The hold shelf closes at six, so go after lunch. Bring the library card.

title: Gift ideas for Dad’s birthday
summary: Wool socks, a new bird book, and maybe tickets to a game. Nothing fancy, just things he would actually use. The green paper is in the drawer.
